text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to amend the parking regulations on both sides of Rosewell Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and Cheritan Avenue, to limit parking to a maximum period of one-hour from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday. The proposed one hour parking limit will address residents' concerns with non-residents parking all day. This activity limits parking availability for residents of Rosewell Avenue. Local residents with a parking permit will be exempt from the one-hour parking limit.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour, from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Rosewell Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and a point 106 metres north of Cheritan Avenue. 2.
